headline: Keep an eye on Environment Agency gauges
intro: Choose a UK Environment Agency flood monitoring station and Home Assistant creates sensors for its measures with readings. The integration polls station data every 15 minutes, so river and flood gauge values can be followed alongside the rest of your home monitoring.
highlights: Choose a station from the list retrieved from the Environment Agency API; each option combines its label and RLOI identifier
Sensor entities report each measure's latest reading and use its unit when available
Station data refreshes every 15 minutes, and a sensor becomes unavailable when its latest reading is missing or archived
